name: @mars/vscode-client
description: VS Code client for the MARS task API: create, approve, steer, cancel and resume tasks; inspect events, diffs, artifacts and checkpoints.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: MARS can request write and execute approvals for this workspace, so it requires a trusted workspace.

mars.serverUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the MARS task server. Loopback only unless `#mars.allowNonLoopbackServer#` is enabled. User settings only; workspace settings cannot redirect your token.

mars.allowNonLoopbackServer.markdownDescription: Allow an HTTPS non-loopback server. Each window still asks for explicit trust, per exact RPC URL, before sending the token.

mars.modelId.markdownDescription: Model id requested when starting a task. Empty uses the server's default free-cloud route. Paid models remain governed by the server's paid-model policy.

mars.requestTimeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout for task server calls.

mars.teamChat.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the Team Chat view. Off by default. With `#mars.teamChat.source#` = `fixture` the view is fed by a deterministic local fixture (`FIXTURE` label) and never contacts a network service.

mars.teamChat.source.markdownDescription: Where Team Chat reads from: the offline `fixture`, or the `@mars/team` `service` at `#mars.teamServerUrl#` using the token set with `MARS: Set team token`. Requests leave only from the extension host; the webview never has network access.

mars.teamServerUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the MARS team service. Loopback only unless `#mars.teamChat.allowNonLoopbackServer#` is enabled (HTTPS required then). Separate from `#mars.serverUrl#`; user settings only.

mars.teamChat.allowNonLoopbackServer.markdownDescription: Allow an HTTPS non-loopback team service. Independent of `#mars.allowNonLoopbackServer#`, which covers the task server only.

scripts.build: bun build src/extension.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external vscode --outfile dist/extension.js && bun build src/webview/main.ts --target=browser --format=iife --outfile dist/webview.js && bun build src/webview/teamChat/main.ts --target=browser --format=iife --outfile dist/team-chat.js
